meta.title: Landscape evidence coverage
meta.scope: Every place in the current pinned geography corpus; reconstruction evidence is added independently for each place.
meta.geometryNote: All candidate coordinates are modern reference points. A point may represent a region or river; it is not an ancient footprint, shoreline, route or dated occupation assertion.
meta.scoreNote: Historical OpenBible source-weighted score (roughly through 2020); not a calibrated probability, current archaeological consensus or an endorsement. Newer findings can change assessments.
meta.corpusScope: Every entry in the pinned OpenBible Protestant-Bible geocoding dataset. Associations can reflect translation variants. Deuterocanonical books are outside this source's scope. Unlocated places are retained without invented coordinates.
meta.generation: Deterministic local build; no network calls or inferred ancient geometry.
meta.additionalAttribution: Source coordinates marked as OpenStreetMap retain © OpenStreetMap contributors attribution and ODbL 1.0 terms.
meta.encyclopediaNote: Article pointers retain revision, contributor-history and CC BY-SA attribution. No Wikipedia article prose is duplicated here.
